title: One Table and Three Chairs: Dhirubhai Ambani's First Trading Room
conflicts: Starting capital: Rs 15,000 (Rediff 2002; Global CEO 2002, which says he took a loan) vs 'a few thousand rupees' (wire-based Rediff profile); both given with attribution. Founding year 1958 (most sources) vs 1957 (Rediff 'Vignettes'); late 1958 used. First office: 350 sq ft room on Narsinatha Street, Masjid Bunder (Rediff) vs a corner of a borrowed office in Bhat Bazaar (Global CEO); both given. Age on leaving for Aden 16 (BBC) vs 17 (Rediff, Global CEO); 'as a teenager' used.
notes: Kept to the 1958 founding and trading years as instructed; no later controversies. Industry changed from the slate's 'retail' to trading. Company field written 'Reliance Commercial Corp (later Reliance Industries)' to avoid a false repeat match on 'Corporation' with the Coulter edition; prose uses the full name. Damani partnership rests on Rediff's 2002 'Vignettes' piece. No Reliance-owned source was usable (ril.com and the Jio Institute archive did not load for the verifier).
